info.title: CloudGuard API
info.description: Intelligent Cloud Security & Resource Monitoring System. Authenticate via **/api/auth/login** and use the access token as a Bearer token.

post.description: Register a user. The very first account becomes the administrator; later accounts are regular users.
Revoke the given refresh token (or all of the user's refresh tokens if none supplied).

get.description: Security audit log of user activity and administrative actions.
Download the (filtered) audit log as CSV (max 50,000 rows).
Current real-time metrics (psutil) plus OS information and health.
Historical metrics, downsampled to at most `max_points` samples.

schema.title: Response History Api Monitoring History Get

get.description: Top running processes (admin only: process lists can reveal sensitive information).

schema.title: Response Devices Api Monitoring Devices Get

get.description: Search and filter alerts. status=active returns open + acknowledged. Demo alerts are excluded by default.

schema.title: Response Rules Api Security Rules Get

post.description: Scan one (or all enabled) monitored directories against their baseline.
Accept current state as the new trusted baseline.

get.description: Model status, scored recent metrics (normal vs abnormal) and stored anomaly records.
System health diagnostics: database, migrations, background loops, collector, storage, integrations.
Notification history for the signed-in user (newest first).
Incidents visible to the user. `status=open` returns everything not yet resolved.

post.description:
Execute an authorised response action (admins) or record a manual one (admins or assignee).

A failed action is still recorded (status `failed`) so the timeline reflects what was attempted.

get.description:
Graph of monitored infrastructure (nodes, edges, health, active alert counts).

Regular users only see containers/VMs assigned to them. `include_demo=true` returns the
separate, labelled demonstration environment instead of real infrastructure.

schema.title: Response List Checks Api Compliance Checks Get

post.description: Add a custom (manually assessed) checklist item.
Record the result of a manual checklist item together with evidence.
Evaluate every enabled check now and store a posture snapshot.

get.description: Latest posture snapshot (null if the checklist has never been run).

schema.title: Response Posture Api Compliance Posture Get

get.description:
Measured utilisation, linear trend and threshold estimates for CPU, memory, disk and network.

Every projected value is tagged `kind: "estimate"`; observed values are `kind: "measured"`.
Returns `status: "insufficient_data"` with an explanation when history is too short.

parameters.name: demo

schema.description: Analyse the labelled demonstration node instead of this host
schema.title: Demo

parameters.description: Analyse the labelled demonstration node instead of this host

get.description: State of the labelled demonstration environment and the available scenarios.

post.description: Delete all demonstration data. Real infrastructure data is not affected.
